messages:
lina_sales: Hey team — Acme POC kicks off tomorrow. They want a hosted API key that we can hand them for the demo but that auto-expires and can be revoked easily. Any objections to provisioning a 72h ephemeral key with IP allowlist and scoped permissions?
noah_se: +1, that sounds right. prefer 'least-privilege' scopes: generation only for chat + embeddings read if they need similarity.
eve_security: OK with ephemeral. Two asks: 1) label keys with customer/poc id for auditing, 2) ensure key creation goes through the service account so audit logs show who created it. Also enable KMS-wrapped secret in the backend.
sam_infra: we can create a short-lived hosted key via our admin API. Plan: create key with metadata {"poc":"acme","owner":"lina_sales"}, set expires_at = now + 72h, and apply IP allowlist CIDRs they provided. We'll also generate a rotation token so they can request a new key if needed.
lina_sales: acme provided IPs: 34.122.18.0/24 and 3.10.45.12/32. Also they asked about how to rotate without service interruption during the demo — any playbook?
sam_infra: yes — do a staggered rotate: 1) Create new key with same scopes and allowlist, 2) hand new key to customer, 3) wait 5–10 mins, 4) revoke old key. For automated rotation we can call: 
```bash
redwood admin keys create --scopes="generate,embeddings.read" \n  --metadata='poc:acme,owner:lina_sales' \n  --expires-in=72h \n  --allowlist='34.122.18.0/24,3.10.45.12/32'
```
This returns id and secret. Secret is shown only once.
noah_se: also add a short snippet for revocation and audit lookup: 
```bash
# revoke
redwood admin keys revoke <key_id>
# audit
redwood admin audit logs --filter "metadata.poc=acme"
```
eve_security: Good. For customer-facing docs, include the caution that keys are bearer tokens — avoid embedding in mobile apps. Also confirm we rotate any cached credentials on our side (ingress logs, dashboards).
lina_sales: can ops-bot create the key now so I can send it to them? I'm on the demo call in an hour.
ops-bot: request received. Creating ephemeral key for poc=acme, owner=lina_sales, ttl=72h, allowlist=34.122.18.0/24,3.10.45.12/32.
ops-bot: key created: id=kb_17a2f, secret=sk_live_xxx (shown once). metadata: poc=acme, owner=lina_sales, expires_at=1805382656.
noah_se: Lina — when you send it, use the secure channel (encrypted email or our SSO link). Don't paste the key into the general slack channel.
lina_sales: sending via SSO ephemeral link. Confirmed. Two quick follow-ups: 1) if Acme asks to extend the POC, what’s the extension flow? 2) if they lose the key mid-demo, fast recovery?
sam_infra: 1) extension: update key expires_at via admin API (extend by +n hours) or create a new key and revoke old. 2) recovery: create a new key immediately and hand off — best to have a second backup key provisioned but stored in our vault and only released on request (ops playbook).
eve_security: we prefer create-new-and-revoke-old. Backup keys should be stored in KMS-backed vault with access audited. No long-lived shadow keys.
lina_sales: got it. I'll note this in the POC ticket and include rotation steps for Acme. Thanks all.
ops-bot: ticket updated: SALES-4387 — Acme POC hosted key provisioned (kb_17a2f). Audit link: https://console.redwood.ai/audit?filter=poc:acme
noah_se: quick note for engineering: if the demo needs increased throughput during the call, let us know and we can pin them to a small dedicated pool for the hour rather than increasing token quotas on hosted key. That avoids changing keys mid-demo.
lina_sales: excellent — will ping if they ask. Closing thread after demo unless we need a follow-up.
